source.author: verg
source.text: Hic regina gravem gemmis auroque poposcit implevitque mero pateram, quam Belus et omnes a Belo soliti; tum facta silentia tectis:
source.text_original: Hic regina gravem gemmis auroque poposcit / implevitque mero pateram, quam Belus et omnes / a Belo soliti; tum facta silentia tectis: /
source.text_english: Here the queen asked for a heavy cup, laden with jewels and gold, and filled it with unmixed wine, a cup that Belus and all his descendants were accustomed to use; then silence fell through the house:

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Unde et Dido Sidonia regii generis, cum Aeneam suscepisset hospitio, hac patera Jovi vina delibat, qua Belus et omnes a Belo soliti.
reuse.text_original: Unde et Dido Sidonia regii generis, cum Aeneam suscepisset hospitio, hac patera Jovi vina delibat, qua Belus et omnes a Belo soliti.
reuse.text_english: Whence also Dido of Sidon, of royal lineage, when she had received Aeneas as a guest, poured wine as a libation to Jupiter from that bowl, from which Belus and all who were descended from Belus were accustomed to do so.
